patch_description: This uses a budget-allocation strategy instead of layered regime pulses. It first computes a small ecological mutation budget from observable stress, parent vigor, and population stability, then distributes that budget among mutation operators using evidence-weighted bandit advantage over clone plus under-sampling credit. Stable worlds keep almost all mass on clone with a narrow conservative trickle; injured or declining worlds shift a bounded share toward conservative and standard parametric mutation only when operator evidence/success supports it. This should reduce stable-world cost while preserving adaptive mutation after injury.
